title: Spiritual Resurrection
english: The image of good things is not shown in itself, but rather the truth follows later and shines after. This is like the harvest of the intelligible, which the Savior says is much. In the shadow of the rock, we have the protection, and safety is shown through this protection. Where we become one with Christ, we will attain all help. The bridegroom is asked to leave the unfruitful synagogue and come to those who have risen to heavenly height from a humble and formerly idolatrous soul.

The women who came on the first day of the week at early dawn to the tomb of Jesus and did not find him are an example of this. The tomb of the Lord is called his bed, where we are buried with him. But she did not find him, having heard that he is not there, for he has risen. The watching angels found her, whom she also asks where they have placed the Lord. Having passed by those who were asked, she met him saying 'rejoice', because she had passed by them a little until she found him, and she will not let him go. For she grasped his feet and heard him say 'do not touch me'. The synagogue of apostles is called the house of his mother, to which she went and evangelized the resurrection of Christ, having been anointed with myrrh and frankincense, symbols of burial and resurrection.

The ecclesiastical soul has been offered not only to these things, but also to various spectacles of knowledge. The one who thoroughly distinguishes and finely examines matters would be said to be a kind of perfumer, making fine distinctions and bringing all the words of fragrance to dust.

This is what the bride is now said to be offering. However, perhaps the one who lives according to the spirit, rather than the flesh, and has not fattened their heart, is able to save the varied and all kinds of fragrance, and thus experiences fragrance from all things.

title: Mystical Ascension
english: He creates those who are currently called the myrrh-bearers. One might say that the holy and ecclesiastical soul, having once been a child of God, deserts the gathering of the nations and ascends from the desert, leaving behind the dogmas, words, and actions that God has abandoned, to ascend toward the things of God. This spiritual conjunction is regarded as gold, both precious and divine. For the manifestation of divine union, the ark in the desert was covered with gold both inside and out. Purple is added to the multitude of those who are called to the kingdom.

When a person believes, they receive Christ into their heart, who is the precious pearl. He says that the garment is fashioned from the daughters of Jerusalem through love alone. For God loved the world so much that he sent his only-begotten Son, so that everyone who believes in him may not perish but have eternal life. The Church is called out from among the nations. The day of the passion is named the day of the wedding, the day on which he wedded the Church through his blood.

Her silence signifies obedience to all things, according to the command 'Be silent and listen, Israel'. Alternatively, the two breasts of the bride are the ethical and dogmatic teachings, from which those who are nourished behold God with clarity. The fragrance of the apostolic and evangelical words is what we enjoy until the end. Come, bride, from Lebanon. He teaches us the origin of the bride and that she comes from idolatry.

For Lebanon is a mountain of idolatry from which he says you will come, and you will come through the law, having been ignorant of it, to be instructed in the mystery of Christ. You have inflamed us, my sister bride, and led us to long for you with a single word of confession, which you made rightly by seeing with your inner eyes and submitting to the impulse of your neck; these things are said to her by the angelic powers, the friends of the bridegroom.

title: Duality of the Soul
english: The bride's soul is characterized by a duality, where one eye sees the truth and the other is deceived by vain things.

This duality is significant because the pure eye of the bride has been opened to the nature of the good, and as a result, her friends praise one of her eyes, referring to her as a sister due to her kinship in apathy and as a bride due to her connection to the Logos.
The fact that she sees with one eye, and her soul is not divided into different dispositions, indicates that the position of her neck has perfection, having taken the divine yoke upon itself.

We confess that we have been inspired with wonders, and through this, we understand the sun of righteousness, as it is reflected in her, like a mirror, which is a certain soul and mind that allows us to understand the light.
There is a closed garden, which is closed to the world but opened to the heavenly bridegroom, and in this garden, the spring is sealed by the Holy Spirit, with which we are anointed after baptism.
In this context, virtues are signified through aromas, and the woods of Lebanon signify the prophets.
The myrrh and aloes signify that Christ, being buried, shared with the preceding saints, having descended into Hades and led them up.
On the cross, he took the death that is above human death, and the heart is watchful, as God, he despoiled Hades.
A question is posed, what has your brother done, or what do you have from your brother?
The answer is given in the phrase, the dripping myrrh says the confessing lips, 'death'.
His knees are described as marble pillars, and it is said, let them be bases.
For those being built are built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets.
After the belly, the knees are praised, which are said to be pillars.
